themes.label: Commercial real estate credit cycle
themes.rationale: M&T carries a large CRE and multifamily loan book; underwriting quality and refinancing stress in CRE (especially office and NYC multifamily) directly drive its charge-offs and reserve builds.

themes.label: Net interest margin sensitivity to rate cycle
themes.rationale: As a large regional bank funded heavily by deposits, MTB's earnings are exposed to Fed rate moves and deposit repricing lags, shaping NIM trajectory each cycle.

themes.label: Regional bank deposit funding competition
themes.rationale: Post-2023 deposit flight to money-market funds and larger banks pressures MTB's funding costs and mix, a structural pressure shared across regional banks.
